tools.name: search_destinations
tools.description: Search published destination cities in the ChinaTravelChina catalog

tools.name: get_destination_details
tools.description: Get a published destination city with attractions and routes

tools.name: get_attraction_details
tools.description: Get attraction details and nearby catalog places

tools.name: compare_transport_routes
tools.description: Compare train routes between two cities. Timings are planning ranges, not live seats or fares.

tools.name: find_nearby_attractions
tools.description: Find published attractions near a latitude and longitude.

tools.name: estimate_trip_budget
tools.description: Illustrative budget in Chinese yuan. Demo bands only — not a quote or a live price.

tools.name: generate_itinerary
tools.description: Build a day-by-day plan from published city guides. Live AI generation is not available.

tools.name: get_travel_requirements
tools.description: List travel-requirement orientation pages, or open one by name. These pages do not decide visa eligibility.

tools.name: get_booking_options
tools.description: List booking links when a partner is connected. No live rates or availability.
